response.sql: WITH linked AS (SELECT m.college AS college, i.amount AS amount FROM income i JOIN member mb ON mb.member_id = i.link_to_member JOIN major m ON m.major_id = mb.link_to_major) SELECT college, SUM(amount) AS total_income, SUM(amount) * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM linked) AS fraction_of_total FROM linked GROUP BY college

assumptions.assumption: Inner joins income -> member -> major drop income with no linked member or major. Colleges are grouped by their name, so majors sharing a college name are combined.
The fraction is the college total divided by the total income of all matched income. It is computed as a decimal (not integer division) and left unrounded.
